name: crypto.ecdsa
doc: ECDSA signatures on P-256 and P-384 with RFC 6979 nonces.

items.name: GenerateKey
items.doc: GenerateKey returns a random P-256 private key (32-byte scalar).
items.summary: GenerateKey returns a random P-256 private key (32-byte scalar).

items.name: GenerateKeyP384
items.doc: GenerateKeyP384 returns a random P-384 private key (48-byte scalar).
items.summary: GenerateKeyP384 returns a random P-384 private key (48-byte scalar).

items.name: PublicKey
items.doc: PublicKey returns the 65-byte uncompressed P-256 public key of priv.
items.summary: PublicKey returns the 65-byte uncompressed P-256 public key of priv.

items.name: PublicKeyP384
items.doc: PublicKeyP384 returns the 97-byte uncompressed P-384 public key of priv.
items.summary: PublicKeyP384 returns the 97-byte uncompressed P-384 public key of priv.

items.name: Sign
items.doc: Sign returns an ASN.1 DER P-256 signature of digest (RFC 6979 nonces hedged with randomness).
items.summary: Sign returns an ASN.1 DER P-256 signature of digest (RFC 6979 nonces hedged with randomness).

items.name: SignP384
items.doc: SignP384 returns an ASN.1 DER P-384 signature of digest.
items.summary: SignP384 returns an ASN.1 DER P-384 signature of digest.

items.name: SignP384Raw
items.doc: SignP384Raw returns a deterministic RFC 6979 P-384 signature as r||s (for test vectors).
items.summary: SignP384Raw returns a deterministic RFC 6979 P-384 signature as r||s (for test vectors).

items.name: Verify
items.doc: Verify reports whether sig (strict DER) is a valid P-256 signature of digest by pub.
items.summary: Verify reports whether sig (strict DER) is a valid P-256 signature of digest by pub.

items.name: VerifyP384
items.doc: VerifyP384 reports whether sig (DER) is a valid P-384 signature of digest by pub.
items.summary: VerifyP384 reports whether sig (DER) is a valid P-384 signature of digest by pub.
